package.description: MediaMonkey The Media Organizer for Serious Collectors

en-GB.longDescription: Manage small to large collections of audio files, videos and playlists (100,000+), whether on a hard drive, network, or CDs. Rip CDs, download podcasts, lookup artwork and other missing information online, tag almost any audio or video format, and automatically rename/re-organise files on your hard drive.
